title: Beta Realm Is Online

body: FrozenThrone Beta Realm is now online for testing new systems before they reach production.

title: Working Threw it All
body:
```html
🔥 Development Update #1

FrozenThrone Development Progress

📅 July 26, 2026

Welcome to our first official FrozenThrone Development Update! We've been putting in countless hours behind the scenes preparing the server for launch. Every day we're fixing bugs, improving performance, adding new features, and making sure players have the best Wrath of the Lich King experience possible.

🐞 Bug Fixes & Beta Realm Testing

Our Beta Realm has become our primary testing ground. We've spent a tremendous amount of time identifying bugs, correcting gameplay issues, and improving overall server stability.

One of our biggest projects has been working with MMaps and NPC pathing. Better pathfinding means smoother movement, improved creature AI, and a much more polished gameplay experience throughout Azeroth.

⚔️ Solo Raid Development

Our custom Solo Raid Beta Realm continues to evolve as we test raid scaling, encounters, boss balance, and overall gameplay. Our goal is to allow players to enjoy raid content solo while still maintaining the challenge and excitement that makes Wrath of the Lich King great.

📬 Mail System Complete

The in-game mail system is now fully functional!

  • ✅ Currency rewards are delivered successfully.
  • ✅ Item rewards are delivered correctly.
  • ✅ Future Vote Shop purchases will be delivered through the mail system.

🗳️ Voting System Online

Great news! Our voting system is now fully connected and reward points are collecting correctly.

While we're finishing development of the Vote Shop, keep voting every day to build your points. Once the shop launches, you'll already have rewards waiting for you!

📢 Reminder:
You must be logged into the FrozenThrone website using your game account before voting in order to receive your points.

🌐 Website Improvements

The website continues to receive new features and improvements.

  • ✅ Account Login System
  • ✅ Voting Integration
  • ✅ News System
  • ✅ Player Rankings
  • ✅ Community Forums
  • 🚧 Vote Shop (Coming Soon)

💬 Community Forums

Our forums are now online and ready for the community!

  • 💡 Suggest new features
  • 🐞 Report bugs
  • ❓ Ask questions
  • 💬 Meet other players
  • 📢 Stay informed with future announcements

⚙️ Behind the Scenes

Every day we're continuing to improve FrozenThrone by working on:

  • 🛡️ Server optimization and performance
  • 🧭 MMaps and creature pathing
  • ⚔️ Solo Raid balancing
  • 🏰 Custom NPC development
  • 🌎 World improvements
  • 🔧 Bug fixes and quality-of-life updates
  • 💻 Website features and account integration

🚀 Looking Ahead

Development is moving forward every single day. Our goal is to create a stable, fun, and long-lasting Wrath of the Lich King server that players can enjoy for years to come.

We still have exciting features on the way, including the Vote Shop, more custom systems, additional website improvements, community events, and much more.

❤️ Thank You!

We'd like to thank everyone helping test the Beta Realm and providing feedback. Every bug report, suggestion, and vote helps make FrozenThrone stronger.

💬 Have feedback or found a bug? Leave a comment below or create a thread in the Forums. We appreciate every member of our growing community!

```

title: Shadowmourne Development Update — August 7, 2026
body:
Shadowmourne Development Update

August 7, 2026

Good morning, FrozenThrone community!

It has been a very successful and productive week so far. Today, we will be performing several database updates and bug fixes on the Shadowmourne realm.

Server Status Notice

These updates are expected to be completed without affecting normal gameplay. We do not currently anticipate any server restarts or downtime. However, if an unexpected restart notification appears, we apologize in advance for the brief interruption.

Today’s Update Includes

  • Adjustments to the prices of certain items and services
  • The addition of Dual Specialization
  • Improvements and corrections to several in-game text screens
  • Additional database cleanup and bug fixes
  • General quality-of-life improvements throughout the realm

We appreciate everyone who continues to play, test new features, and report issues. Your feedback helps us improve Shadowmourne and create a better experience for the entire community.

Thank you for being part of FrozenThrone. Enjoy your day—and we’ll see you in Azeroth!

— The FrozenThrone Development Team

title: New Launcher 0.2.1 RELEASE
summary: Launcher 0.2.1 introduces automatic client patching, repair, and future launcher updates.
body:
FrozenThrone Launcher Update

Launcher 0.2.1 Is Now Available

August 15, 2026

We have officially released FrozenThrone Launcher 0.2.1. This update corrects the client patching system and prepares the launcher to handle future updates automatically.

One Final Manual Download

All players must manually download Launcher 0.2.1 from the FrozenThrone website. This should be the final manual launcher download required.

What This Update Changes

  • Corrects where custom game patches are installed.
  • Automatically downloads new and updated client files.
  • Verifies managed files for missing or damaged content.
  • Delivers AddOns, interface improvements, custom MPQs, and other updates.
  • Prepares the launcher to update itself when future launcher versions are released.

What Players Need to Do

  1. Completely close World of Warcraft and the old launcher.
  2. Download and install FrozenThrone Launcher 0.2.1.
  3. Open the new launcher and select your existing Wow.exe if requested.
  4. Click Repair to verify and update your game client.
  5. Wait for the repair to finish before clicking Play.

You do not need to reinstall the entire game client. The Repair system will only download files that are missing, outdated, or damaged.

Future Updates

After installing Launcher 0.2.1, future FrozenThrone and Shadowmourne client patches will be delivered automatically. Simply open the launcher and click Play or Repair to receive the latest managed files.

Thank you for helping us continue improving FrozenThrone and Shadowmourne. We appreciate your patience while we build a smoother and more reliable update experience for everyone.

— The FrozenThrone Team
